privileges.currentProduction: No change made; proposed objects are not installed by this work.
privileges.privateStoreCandidate: postgres owns functions/tables; RLS enabled; PUBLIC, anon, authenticated and service_role have no direct schema/table/function access.
privileges.proposedBoundary: Three original run wrappers propose service-only EXECUTE; the two additional publication wrappers revoke all access until separately reviewed grants. All use empty search_path and postgres ownership.
privileges.browserAccess: None. Browser sends an empty start request or run ID through the existing authenticated Operations bridge.
privileges.rolesAndCredentials: Existing Owner/IT identities and existing platform service credential only. No role memberships, user profiles, secrets or credentials created or changed.

mandatoryChecks: Existing legacy session, active profile, same-person native mapping and native Owner/IT role verified by Operations handler.
Actor and fixed tenant derived server-side; client actor/tenant/roster parameters rejected.
Boundary requires service_role JWT context and service-only EXECUTE privilege.
Every private claim/read/save rechecks active native user profile, organization and matching Owner or IT technician role.
Claims are tenant-locked; saves require current lease, creating actor, immutable run metadata and non-regressing terminal outcomes.
Reads require the authorized tenant; no browser or direct service-role private store access.
whyNeeded: Existing refresh claim stores no run ID/outcomes and does not coalesce. Edge runtime needs bounded durable state without exposing tables or granting browser writes.

readerEvidence.provenance: Earlier authorized read-only Supabase get-function-definition query, cached privately before cancellation notice; no later cancelled read repeated or bypassed.

executionGate: Do not install, grant, deploy, enable runtime or probe before separate production review/approval. Compatible endpoint checker and deployed mapping verification remain required.
rollback: Disable runtime, quiesce/fence writers and revoke service execution on all five boundary functions; retain durable evidence.
releaseBlockers: Production SQL/grants/deployment/enablement require separate approval; new health wrappers intentionally have no service EXECUTE grants.

Native source statement hooks are candidate-only; legacy cross-project source fencing, native readback/admission orchestrators, and scheduled/manual publisher migration remain blocked as enumerated in the protocol. Runtime stays disabled.
Native health is authoritative; no legacy replication or cross-project transaction is claimed.
reviewRegressionEvidence: Held source-Field rows stay in the run/report as unverified; cached actual projection adapter yields 135 total, 41 Field, 94 Shop (local metadata digest for older cached fixture, no identity claims).

Local PostgreSQL 17 independent connections prove claim/save lock waits, same-lease continuation, supersession rejection and expired-success rejection. Synthetic disposable container has network disabled.
No cancelled function-definition read repeated; no production access, grants, probes, writes, merge or deployment.
